evals.name: reject-out-of-bounds-line-range
evals.prompt: Grade an s2_01 audit claim citing backend/src/app/main.py:9999-10050
evals.expected_output: Downgrades score from 3 to 1 because lines 9999-10050 exceed the file line count
expectations: Verifies cited line numbers against actual line count of the file on disk
Automatically downgrades score when line range is out of bounds

evals.name: reject-paper-architecture-markdown-only
evals.prompt: Grade an s2_01 engineering audit claim citing only ARCHITECTURE.md:10-40
evals.expected_output: Downgrades score from 3 to 1 due to Paper Architecture Disqualifier
expectations: Requires executable code/IaC/test file extensions for Section 2 competencies
Caps markdown-only Section 2 citations at Score 1

evals.name: reject-sycophantic-zero-gap-claims
evals.prompt: Grade a Score 3 claim whose failures_and_gaps is 'None' or 'No issues'
evals.expected_output: Downgrades score from 3 to 2 due to Sycophancy Disqualifier
expectations: Requires explicit operational trade-off or failure-mode documentation for Score 3

evals.name: enforce-programmatic-circuit-breaker-hotpath-check
evals.prompt: Verify s2_21 circuit breaker is actively enforced via allow_request() in catalog.py
evals.expected_output: Downgrades s2_21 to Score 2 if catalog_circuit_breaker.allow_request() is not checked in query_catalog
expectations: Detects dead-path circuit breakers that record state without blocking requests when OPEN

evals.name: enforce-post-generation-sku-citation-scrubber-and-no-regex-json
evals.prompt: Verify s2_02 post-generation SKU citation verification and s2_03 schema-constrained JSON parsing in orchestrator.py
evals.expected_output: Downgrades s2_02/s2_03 if verify_and_scrub_sku_citations is missing or regex JSON extraction is used
expectations: Verifies verify_and_scrub_sku_citations is called on LLM synthesis output
Verifies _rerank_with_llm does not use fragile regex JSON array parsing
